text: Five crops grow wild out there, each in its own country. Find a patch, pick it, and what you picked is the seed: plant it on tilled ground like a potato.
- **Emberroot** in the Ember Wastes: a hot red tuber.
pages.title: What the March grows

text: They grow through four stages on farmland. All of them can be eaten raw, though not for much. The [Spiritgear Hoe](spiritgear) reaps and replants them in one stroke, bees pollinate them, and the [Sprout boon](tribe_boons) hurries them along.
Frostberry and Glimmer Bean also count as herbs for the [Spirit Kettle](spirit_kettle).
